svg.title: module1_v1: operating modes
svg.text: Operating modes: the chip has no valves, so the ports do the routing
chip/module1_v1.json · one plan view per mode · a driven port is a source and a capped port is a true block, so the vented port is the drain
FALLBACK ONLY. Cells enter p_in and cross n_cx toward g_cx and a_cx, but most
settle long before they arrive, so each chamber is normally seeded through its own inlet.
pressurised: p_in | vented: p_g_out, p_a_out | blocked: p_g_in, p_a_in, p_mid
Three media in, one drain at p_mid. The weeks-long differentiation mode.
pressurised: p_in, p_g_in, p_a_in | vented: p_mid | blocked: p_g_out, p_a_out
N medium leaves n_cx, reaches the junction and splits to g_cx and a_cx.
pressurised: p_in | vented: p_g_out, p_a_out | blocked: p_g_in, p_a_in, p_mid
G medium leaves g_cx, reaches the junction and splits to n_cx and a_cx.
pressurised: p_g_in | vented: p_in, p_a_out | blocked: p_a_in, p_mid, p_g_out
A medium leaves a_cx, reaches the junction and splits to n_cx and g_cx.
pressurised: p_a_in | vented: p_in, p_g_out | blocked: p_g_in, p_mid, p_a_out
pushes its medium in. Fluid cannot leave through it, so it blocks.
open to the air. Flow goes here: it is the drain.
capped. Nothing moves in or out.
flow direction in this mode. Colour is the port that feeds it;
dark grey is a channel carrying more than one medium.
Every mode is a different pressure map on the same board; nothing on it moves. Arrows are derived from the port states, not simulated.
Channels narrower than 0.31 mm are drawn that wide so the arrows fit (narrowest is 0.2 mm). The port table is in fig_modes() in cad/make_figures.py.
